decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun on or before 17/01/2021.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement Ref: RC 946; NE2017_0095B_SD_001 Rev: 00; NE2017_0144B_946_101 Rev: 00; NE2017_0144B_946_102 Rev: 00; NE2017_0144B_946_103 Rev: 00. Received: 21/11/2017. S9840. Received: 16/01/2018 as approved under application 01145/O/S220/P2, Letter dated 14/02/2018 Received: 14/02/2018 and TFL_004 Rev: A Received: 22/02/2018 under this application. by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The necessary road markings to designate the space for use by electric vehicles shall be in place prior to the commencement of the operational use of the hereby approved Electric Charging Point and its associated works, and shall be permanently maintained as such to ensure access for all electric vehicles.
description: Removal of condition 5 (retractable cabling) of planning permission 01145/O/S220/P1 dated 18/01/2018 for  Installation of a Rapid Charging Point for electric vehicles, feeder pillar and associated works
